description: This file contains the server-side logic for the 'StartExam' page in an online examination system. classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam.aspx page handling user interactions and exam initialization.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page, checks user session, fetches user semester, and populates the course dropdown accordingly.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam, sets session variables, and checks availability of exam questions in the database.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exams, checks if already taken, and initiates exam if not.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exams, checks if already taken, and initiates exam if not.
